task.title: Provide one canonical stored market snapshot contract for paper

owned_layer: The read-only Source endpoint and normalized SourceRecord ingest projection.
Paper CurrentArtifactStrategy RuntimeBinding policy selection, typed stale/missing rejection, and input lineage propagation.
Focused Source endpoint, zero-egress, producer integration, stale-input, and no-static-fallback tests.
not_changing: Source controller mode, scheduler topology, or any continuous provider connection.
A new market-data service, live feed, live trading, or capital activation.
RuntimeBinding write authority, artifact loader ownership, or the explicitly selected smoke/profile strategy.

canonical_contract.ingest_projection: LatestMarketSnapshotStore.append_normalized_records() accepts only already-normalized SourceRecords from the existing completed ingest path.

storage.integrity: append-only JSONL envelopes with per-entry sha256 checksums; malformed history fails closed

endpoint.read_safety: The handler calls only LatestMarketSnapshotStore.get(); it has no connector, provider, configured fetcher, or scheduler access.

paper_policy.rollback: No signal is enqueued; PaperSignalProducer reports the typed degraded binding.

canonical_client.disposition: Retained as the sole normal artifact-runner snapshot client; validates policy, snapshot ID, event time, lineage, minimum closes, and age.

canonical_provider.contract: Completed ingest projects normalized SourceRecord metadata; GET returns the persisted projection.
canonical_provider.disposition: Added as the single Source authority; no provider egress on reads.

retired_or_excluded_paths.disposition: Removed. A RuntimeBinding cannot emit an artifact-runner signal from fixed binding/metadata closes.
Explicit PAPER_SIGNAL_STRATEGY=smoke profile/test path only; it is not a CurrentArtifactStrategy snapshot client and is not selected by the deployable default.

results: 66 passed in 22.30 seconds; one upstream FastAPI TestClient deprecation warning.
Endpoint contract test proves the stored normalized response has symbol, snapshot ID, latest event time, lineage, and ordered closes.
Zero-egress test replaces both the scheduler and urllib.request.urlopen with forbidden implementations before GET; the stored snapshot is still returned.

Producer integration test requires the RuntimeBinding policy and carries Source snapshot ID/lineage into signal metadata; stale test returns market_input_stale with zero queued signals; recent_closes test returns market_input_missing with zero queued signals.

review_decision.reviewer_action_required: Antigravity must independently inspect this committed manifest and exact task-branch head, rerun the focused suite, verify the endpoint/client audit, and bind canonical approval with this review_file before merge.
